Hi Lena — great conversation today, thanks for carving out the time. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can move the pilot/POC discussion forward: 

Summary of what we heard (from today's call):
- Primary use case: inference for clinical summarization and patient-facing content generation; latency requirement ~ <200ms p95 for short prompts.
- Success metrics: 95% uptime SLA, cost target below $0.015/token (estimated), model quality measured by your internal eval set (we discussed a sample prompt set).
- Compliance: SOC 2 required; data residency for PHI in your regional cloud.

Asks / next steps:
1) Can you share a simple org chart or list of the key decision contacts (economic buyer, legal counsel, procurement lead, and security contact)?
2) Any timing constraints for procurement / contract cycle we should be aware of?
3) I'll attach a short evaluation template we use to align success criteria — feel free to fill what you can.
4) Would you be able to introduce the procurement lead and legal/infosec owner on a 30-min intro call next week? We can bring a brief SOW and a security checklist.

I'm copying Rachel (AE manager) and Priyom (solutions engineering) so we can loop them in later this week.

Thanks — happy to help coordinate.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez

Sergio / Lena — thanks for the context. A couple of procurement notes from our side: 

- Typical timeline: 3–4 weeks for standard SaaS agreements once scope and SOW are provided. If PHI or custom data residency is required, add 2–4 weeks for vendor risk and legal review.
- Please send an initial SOW and indicative pricing; procurement will need contract term, termination provisions, and a data processing addendum (DPA).
- We use DocuSign for final signatures; procurement@greenwavehealth.com will be the address to route to.

If you can send the SOW draft and a short pricing summary, I can kick off the vendor review. Would propose a 30-min introduction/overview next Tue 2/17 10:00–10:30 AM ET — if that works we can invite legal and infosec.
